q: In which country is the SCO Secretariat located?
a: Beijing, China.
rel: • The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation’s Secretariat is in Beijing. • Its Regional Anti-Terrorist Structure (RATS) Executive Committee is in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

q: Who is the President of Türkiye?
a: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, as of 21 October 2026.
rel: • He has been President of Türkiye since 2014. • This is a current office-holder question and should be rechecked before the examination.

q: Which gas is essential for human breathing?
a: Oxygen (O₂).
rel: • Oxygen supports cellular respiration in humans. • Air contains about 21% oxygen by volume.

q: Over how many years were the Madani revelations sent down?
a: Madani revelations occurred during approximately the 10 years after the Hijrah, within the Qur’an’s overall 23-year revelation period.
rel: • The Hijrah occurred in 622 CE. • “Madani” typically refers to revelation after the Hijrah, even if the revelation occurred outside Madinah.

q: What was the name of Chaudhry Rahmat Ali’s famous pamphlet/book?
a: Now or Never: Are We to Live or Perish Forever? (1933).
rel: • Chaudhry Rahmat Ali used the name “Pakistan” in this pamphlet. • The booklet was published in Cambridge, England.

q: What was the Tashkent Agreement/Declaration?
a: The Tashkent Declaration was signed by India and Pakistan on 10 January 1966.
rel: • It followed the 1965 war. • Soviet Premier Alexei Kosygin mediated the talks in Tashkent, then in the Uzbek SSR.

q: What was Hazrat Abu Bakr’s (RA) personal name?
a: Abdullah ibn Abi Quhafa (commonly given as Abu Bakr’s personal name Abdullah).
rel: • Abu Bakr (RA) was the first Rashidun Caliph. • He was a close companion of Prophet Muhammad and father of Aishah (RA).

q: In which Ghazwa were Prophet Muhammad’s teeth injured?
a: Ghazwa-e-Uhud (3 AH / 625 CE).
rel: • Prophet Muhammad was injured during the battle. • Hazrat Hamza (RA) was also martyred at Uhud.

q: How many surahs are named after Prophet Muhammad ?
a: One surah is directly named Muhammad: Surah Muhammad (Surah 47).
rel: • Most surah names refer to people, events, or distinctive words, and only one is called Muhammad. • It is classified as Madani in the common traditional division.

q: How many Houses are in Pakistan’s Parliament?
a: Two Houses: the National Assembly and the Senate. Strictly, Article 50 says Parliament consists of the President and both Houses.
rel: • The National Assembly is the lower house; the Senate is the upper house. • The Senate represents the federating units and is not dissolved with the National Assembly.

q: What does SUPARCO stand for?
a: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission.
rel: • SUPARCO is Pakistan’s national space agency. • It was established in 1961 and its headquarters is in Islamabad.

q: In which year was the OIC formed?
rel: • The Organisation of Islamic Cooperation was established after a summit in Rabat in September 1969. • Its headquarters is in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
